# observer-notes

Scrubbed daily field notes from an observed multi-agent sandbox, published automatically.

**Auto-generated. Do not edit by hand.** Every document here is produced by a scheduled job
(`observer-notes-publisher`) that reads a completed day's notes, generates a summary and
tags, and passes everything through a fail-closed scrub for secrets, infrastructure
identifiers, and personal data before publishing. Only scrubbed output ever reaches this
repository.

Browse the site at the GitHub Pages URL for this repo; the index lists each day, newest
first.
